exposure: Near-infrared (NIR)-indocyanine green (ICG) imaging for bowel vascularization assessment
outcome: Fluorescence degree of the anastomotic line
Adverse reactions related to ICG use
cohort: Thirty-two women with symptomatic rectosigmoid endometriosis (RSE) who underwent discoid or segmental bowel resection were included.
finding: NIR-ICG imaging for anastomotic perfusion assessment after discoid or segmental resection for RSE seems to be a feasible, safe, and reproducible method.
